shellCommands.command: curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ | head -40 && echo "---ADD---" && curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d 'title=The+Left+Hand+of+Darkness&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin&notes=Cold+and+clear.' && echo "---LIST---" && curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ && echo "---JSON---" && cat data/books.json
node server.js > /tmp/books-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! && sleep 0.4 && curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/ && echo && cat /tmp/books-server.log

set -e
echo "=== HOME ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3000/
echo
echo "=== ADD ==="
curl -sS -D - -o /tmp/add-body.html -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data-urlencode "title=The Left Hand of Darkness" --data-urlencode "author=Ursula K. Le Guin" --data-urlencode "notes=Cold and clear."
echo
echo "=== BOOK ==="
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "id=$ID"
curl -sS "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID"
echo
echo "=== FINISH ==="
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish"
echo
echo "=== AFTER ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3000/
echo
echo "=== MISSING ==="
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nope
echo "=== JSON ==="
cat data/books.json
kill $(lsof -t -i:3000) 2>/dev/null || true
fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null || kill 451 2>/dev/null || true; ss -ltnp | grep 3000 || echo "port free"
